messages.subject: Stratton Energy supply agreement — engagement
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Rebecca,

Great to speak earlier. Attached is our engagement letter for the Stratton Energy supply agreement. As discussed, James Osei will run the day-to-day with Elena Marchetti supporting, and I'll supervise. Our fee estimate is £38k–£52k plus VAT.

If you can sign and return the letter and complete the client ID form, we'll get straight onto the heads of terms.

Kind regards,
Sarah

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Signed letter attached and ID form completed separately. Daniel is keen to move quickly — Stratton want heads of terms before month end. The £3.2m annual commitment is the key thing for us; please make sure that's nailed down.

Thanks,
Rebecca
Finance Director, Harrow Precision Engineering
